title: Intersystem-crossing and triplet-decay rates
summary: Evidence-backed QM provider selection, finite acquisition planning and matched TI/TD rate calculation through existing scientific owners; missing capabilities stop the workflow before execution.
gates: Select installed QM providers only from method-, basis- and state-specific certified capability evidence
Missing operator, derivative, complete nonadiabatic operator or outgoing-channel solver raises MissingPhotophysicalCapability and submits zero jobs
Preserve state identity, complex phases, channel populations and common coordinate/energy references
Finite explicitly authorized electronic points; no added keywords or implicit substitutions
Matched TI/TD fields, electronic gap, temperature, operator and physical energy-conservation model
Harmonic, perturbative, selected variational and DVR/bath nuclear models retain their existing owners and validation gates
An explicit verified compute host and bounded resources are required; reuse completed data and checkpoints
coordinate_policy: Frozen nonredundant internal coordinates by default; transport nuclear fields and all transition operators together. Shared-mode or state-specific bases are explicit.
backend_policy: Prefer Gaussian for analytic nuclear fields and optical derivatives, ORCA for scalar-state SOC, and TURBOMOLE for certified nonadiabatic response data; actual installed method/basis/state capability evidence is mandatory. A program name is not evidence of a supported property. No missing-data approximation is inferred.
